purpose: One correction after crumpled delta-only trial01; smooth local target on the same original marked SPAN, retaining protrusion and actual coarse/fine rim anchors.

recipe.averaging: Arithmetic average of unique neighbors on actual preserved coarse quad edges.
recipe.substep: P <- P + coefficient*effective_coarse_mask*(neighbor_mean(P)-P); anchors and mask-zero controls remain exact at every substep.
recipe.coarse_geometry: Actual latest source G7.xyz[:coarse_vertex_count]; no earlier coarse-stage XYZ is substituted.
recipe.lift: At each actual saved stage linearly lift mask as old-V, endpoint mean, face mean. Reconstruct target XYZ with actual neutral Catmull-Clark stencils and verify exact saved child face order.
recipe.lift_scope: Linear V/E/F mask interpolation; actual neutral-CC smooth target construction from current-G7 coarse prefix. Not historical growth replay.
recipe.radial_direction: Fixed actual input G7 XY radial direction, applied once to FINAL target-minus-source blended displacement.
recipe.radial_anchor_rule: Within selected coarse mask, group by floor(atan2(abs(Y),abs(X))/.06) and floor((Z-source_zmin)/(.025H)); retain radius >= bin maximum-.0005H. Union actual X/Y ID orbits.
recipe.anchor_neighborhood: Two actual quad-edge averages of binary movable weights, resetting all anchor weights to zero after each average; multiply the supplied lifted feather mask. Mask-zero source stays exact.
recipe.target_formula: target=neutral_CC^3(filtered_actual_G7_coarse_prefix); delta=(target-actual_G7)*blend_mask, then final radial attenuation, actual-ID reflection, smooth norm cap and exact anchor pins.
recipe.radial_anchor_scope: Fixed selected original coarse controls plus selected actual G7 fine radial crests. Both are fixed exactly in the final output.
recipe.displacement_cap: D <- D*(B*tanh(norm(D)/B)/norm(D)), B=.0075H; zero displacement remains zero.
recipe.reflection: Frozen whole_field._transport reflects minimum-ID representative delta through actual commuting source X/Y involutions; input geometry is not reconstructed.
recipe.mask_scope: Supplied selected WALL-born overlap-band feather mask, not a new root/end-cap semantic classifier.
recipe.preservation: Exact faces/classes/rest/anchors/chart and source coordinates where full lifted mask is zero; exact original coarse and selected actual-G7 radial anchors.
recipe.smooth_target_CC_evaluations: Actual count of supplied coarse-to-source saved levels; output generation stays G7, added subdivision generations=0.
recipe.interpretation: Local geometry fairing to organize existing ornament junctions. No new ornament or detail, no guaranteed G1 continuity, no collision repair, and no automatic visual success.

camera.scope: Approximate trace of the user-marked band in the exact saved close camera; original native image is not edited.

selected_region.target: Original WALL-born irregular overlap band in the user annotation; not later top Task32 events or ATTACHED_LEAF.
